summary: Rooms: each one is a calendar (a calendar column).
purpose: Appointments are booked in a room. Optionally it syncs with a Google Calendar.
tips: In the access tab you choose which doctors can use each room.

config.calendars.field.color.description: Color it shows with on the calendar.

config.calendars.field.google_calendar_i.description: Optional: Google Calendar id to sync the appointments.

config.calendars.tab.access.description: Doctors who can see patients in this room.
